page.title: Goals
page.intro: Goals turn support into a journey. Publish up to three at a time — progress comes from real Tees, never a number you type in.
page.unavailable: Goals aren't available right now. Please try again shortly.

manager.activeCount: {count} of {max, plural, one {# active goal} other {# active goals}} on your page
manager.emptyBody: Good goals are specific and real: a season of green fees, travel to a qualifier, tournament entries, a coaching block. For instance “Q-School entry fee — £425” <example>(Example)</example>. Goals you publish appear on your page with honest progress.
manager.coverHelp: JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 5 MB. Shown at the top of this goal's card on your page.
manager.milestoneReached: 🎉 Goal reached! Share the moment with your supporters.
manager.milestoneProgress: 🏌️ You're {percent}% of the way there — a great time to share.
manager.takenDown: This goal was removed by BuyMeATee and can't be published. If you think this is a mistake, contact support.

form.descriptionPlaceholder: Tell supporters what this goal makes possible — green fees, travel, entries, coaching.
form.currencyLockedHelp: This goal has received support, so its currency can't change.
form.currencyPayoutHelp: Goals use your payout currency so supporters can fund them.

page.title: Updates
page.intro: Show supporters where their backing goes — new features, milestones, rounds played. Drafts stay private until you publish them.
page.unavailable: Updates aren't available right now. Please try again shortly.

manager.emptyBody: Updates are how supporters see their backing turn into real progress — new features, milestones, a round played. Post your first one.
manager.imageHelp: JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 5 MB. Shown with this update on your page.
manager.shareTitle: Update published — share it with your supporters.

form.bodyPlaceholder:
What's new? Supporters love seeing progress.

Markdown works: **bold**, - lists, and [links](https://…).

page.title: Wish list
page.intro: List specific things a supporter can fund outright — a box of balls, a tournament entry, a coaching session, a beer after a round. They sit alongside your bigger goals. An item shows as funded only once a real Tee pays for it.
page.unavailable: Your wish list isn't available right now. Please try again shortly.

manager.itemCount: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} on your page
manager.emptyBody: Wish-list items are specific and tangible: a box of balls, a tournament entry, a coaching session, travel to a qualifier, even a beer after a good round. For instance “A dozen tour balls — £45” <example>(Example)</example>. Supporters fund the whole item in one Tee.
manager.imageHelp: JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 5 MB. A clear photo helps supporters picture what they're funding.
manager.fundedNote: A supporter funded this — thank them on your next update!

form.descriptionPlaceholder: What it is and why it would make a difference — the model, the event, the trip.
form.priceHelp: One supporter funds the whole item, so keep it to what a single Tee can cover.
form.priceLockedHelp: This item has been funded, so its price can't change.
form.currencyLockedHelp: This item has been funded, so its currency can't change.
form.currencyPayoutHelp: Items use your payout currency so supporters can fund them.

payments.title: Tees received
payments.readyBody: Payments are enabled. Stripe pays out to your bank on your Stripe payout schedule.
payments.setupBody: Set up payments to start receiving Tees.
payments.payoutNote: Gift amounts are what senders chose for you. Stripe handles payouts — a paid Tee is in your Stripe account, not necessarily in your bank yet.
payments.empty: No Tees yet. Share your page to let supporters join your journey.
payments.shareNews: Share the news with your audience
